_note: dev_process_hygiene's behaviour depends on the LIVE process table, which CONTRACT.md #6 'Stubbing external commands' explicitly forbids reproducing between two sequential runs -- 'list_processes cases are parity-exempt (parity: false, exception PE-6) and are covered by unit tests against a stubbed ctx.list_processes instead'. Every case below except dph-quiet-stop-hook-active is therefore parity:false. The real, currently-runnable behavioural proof (orphan found / no orphan / dead-parent detection / PE-12 python3+node.exe/draw.io.exe pairing / max_listed / cmdline_truncate / message placeholders) lives in tests/test_dev_processes.py against a stubbed process table -- see that file's own header for why the stub is applied to lib.procs.list_processes rather than ctx.list_processes (a reported gap in lib/procs.py's find_dev_processes, not fixed here).

The ONE dev_process_hygiene case that IS genuinely parity-safe and needs no process stub: the dispatcher's stop_hook_active short-circuit fires before the guard (or the old .ps1's own top-of-file check) ever touches the process table, so both sides deterministically return 0 regardless of real machine state.

PE-6: Get-CimInstance/Stop-Process/netstat (old) -> psutil process_iter/terminate+wait_procs+kill/net_connections (new). One cross-platform path instead of two OS branches. Semantic proof: tests/test_dev_processes.py::test_orphan_found, test_no_orphan, test_dead_parent_detection.

PE-12: name set bash.exe/sh.exe/node.exe/tail.exe/workerd.exe/python.exe/draw.io.exe matched by base name (trailing .exe stripped only) PLUS python3, the one deliberate effective-set addition never in the master's $NAMES. Semantic proof: tests/test_dev_processes.py::test_pe12_and_exe_stripping (python3 orphan flagged; node.exe -> 'node' still matches; draw.io.exe keeps its internal dot).

PE-10: the master hardcodes `powershell ... stop-dev-orphans.ps1` and literal ports 8788/5173; the port renders {python_exe} "{deploy_dir}/stop_dev_orphans.py" and ports from dev_processes.ports. Semantic proof: tests/test_dev_processes.py::test_message_placeholders_resolved.
